idle.note: ragged breathing: the hunched torso heaves in two short uneven breaths, the bowed head twitches once, the clawed hand flexes, the heavy rod arm hangs and sways; knees stay bent; no whole-body bob

move.note: a lurching shamble: heavy alternating steps, the hunched torso pitches forward on each, the rod arm trails, the clawed arm swings

tether.note: hauls the rod up and holds it out toward its partner; the body tenses and shudders while the beam holds (contact), then lowers

jab.note: rears back, then drives the rod forward in a short heavy thrust (contact); recoils

death.note: jolts upright as the charge leaves it, then the knees buckle and it pitches forward over the rod onto its knees, head down; terminal pose held
